correctness.rationale: For the standard Cerny n-state cyclic letter a and single-merging b, the submitted piecewise integer rank D(i,j) partitions all unordered pairs into the complete interval 1..binom(n,2). Each pair has exactly one letter reducing D by one and no letter reducing it more than one, so it equals the minimum merge length and fixes the unique shortest word. The rank-N descent gives explicit W_n whose suffixes are the unique shortest words. Independent reverse pair-BFS and rank-transition checks for n=2..26 corroborated both parity cases; all-n justification is the piecewise case proof.
